subject: general
question: Simplify the following expression: (x - y - z) ^ 2 - (x + y + z) ^ 2
solution:
**Given:**

Expression: (x - y - z)² - (x + y + z)²

**Formula Used:**

(a - b)² = a² - 2ab + b²

(a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b²

**Calculation:**

⇒ (x - y - z)² = x² - 2x(y + z) + (y + z)²

⇒ (x + y + z)² = x² + 2x(y + z) + (y + z)²

⇒ (x - y - z)² - (x + y + z)² = [x² - 2x(y + z) + (y + z)²] - [x² + 2x(y + z) + (y + z)²]

⇒ (x - y - z)² - (x + y + z)² = x² - 2x(y + z) + (y + z)² - x² - 2x(y + z) - (y + z)²

⇒ (x - y - z)² - (x + y + z)² = -4x(y + z)

**∴ The correct answer is -4x(y + z).**
